snippet.title: DARKEST PATH REVEAL TRAİLER
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4590680/Darkest_Path/
Enter a world where hope is a forgotten relic. Darkest PAth is a fast-paced, 2.5D action roguelike
Fight through twisted corridors, master dark rituals, and face grotesque horrors in a quest for survival. Every death is a lesson; every run is a new descent into madness.

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/afcskwwKGe
Follow on Twitter/X: https://x.com/DarkestPath2
Follow on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/
